title: The Greenwich Village Food Tour
includes: Included is the cost of a licensed and professional guide.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Tour is recommended for anyone who can handle 5,000 steps in the weather condition of that day.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Greenwich Village is one of the most popular neighborhoods in NYC, with many stars living there, and their shows and movies being filmed there! A wealth of food options will be available from bagels with cream cheese, delicious, Margherita pizza (NYCs best!) Rice balls, falafel, award winning chocolates, and cupcakes. There’s plenty of walking to burn off those calories. Well see the sights of the gay liberation movement, the Friends apartment, many different historic and modern speakeasies, as well as the trendiest streets in NYC for music and nightlife. If the guest purchases one of every item as recommended by the guide they will spend $6 on food per person, before desserts.
